blocks.headline: Union and City Reach Interim Deal
paras: The union agreed to suspend the strike and the city **to review pay**. Talks will resume Monday and **may continue** through the weekend. Neither side would say whether concessions were large or **small**.
“We were prepared to walk away, **but didn’t**,” said union leader Ines Alba. Asked whether the mayor had been flexible, aides said **he had**.

frames.title: Elipse: omitir o que já foi dito

head: Tipo
Exemplo
rows: The union agreed to suspend the strike and (the city) **to review pay**.
We were prepared to walk away, **but didn’t** (walk away).
Had the mayor been flexible? — **He had.**
They wanted to meet; I didn’t want **to** (meet).
blocks.cap: Elipse: omitir o que já foi dito

blocks.body: Omita só o que o leitor **recupera facilmente**. Mantenha o **auxiliar** (had, did, may) e *to*.
Não omita o auxiliar quando mudar o tempo: *I haven’t finished but she has* ✓; *she did* ✗ (sem referência).

items.s: We were prepared to walk away, but we ___ . (did not)
He wanted to leave, and she wanted ___ too. (to)
Was the mayor flexible? — Aides said he ___ . (be, past)
Talks resume Monday and ___ continue through the weekend. (may)

body: **Neither here nor there.** — Irrelevante.
**Say no more.** — Não precisa dizer mais.
**You bet.** — Pode apostar.
**If so.** — Se for assim.
**If not.** — Se não.
**Not that I know of.** — Que eu saiba, não.
**So I hear.** — Pelo que ouço.
**Be that as it may.** — Seja como for.
**Needless to say.** — Nem é preciso dizer.
**Did the union walk away?** — O sindicato abandonou a mesa?
**They were prepared to, but didn’t.** — Estavam dispostos, mas não abandonaram.
**Was the mayor flexible?** — O prefeito foi flexível?
